description: Vervoersnetwerken: Spoorwegen - Transport Networks: Rail (INSPIRE geharmoniseerd) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by api.pdok.nl. INSPIRE Transport networks: Railways (Transport Networks: Rail) thematic layer, harmonised, filled with relevant objects from TOP10NL (part of the Basic Registration Topography BRT), produced and managed by the Land Registry. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Transport networks: Railways - Transport Networks: Rail (INSPIRE harmonized)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include vervoersnetwerken, spoorwegen, rail, transport networks, transport. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
